lead.question: 哈里为什么最终放弃了他那套在化妆品店恶作剧的小把戏？
lead.warmup: 本课讲一个爱开玩笑的表兄哈里。他在书房里常年摆着一只形状古怪的淡绿色瓶子，里面装着黏稠发灰的东西，他会一本正经地告诉你那是“香水泥”——一种加了香料的泥。他最爱玩的游戏，是走进名贵化妆品商店，当场编出并不存在的货名，看售货员东翻西找、手足无措。这一次他走进伦敦一家高级商店，索要一种叫“密诺莱特”的东西，最后顺口要了香水泥，等着对方发愣。
goals: 读懂哈里从恶作剧到花钱认输的完整故事，把握作者的幽默与讽刺
掌握 mud, cosmetic, disguise, remedy 等本课核心词汇及固定搭配
理解并运用被动语态、让步从句、定语从句等本课重点结构
能用英语复述哈里“买下香水泥”的经过，并说出它的代价
lead.summary: 课文先设悬念：书房里那只古怪瓶子装的到底是什么？接着交代那确实是香水泥，并由此引出哈里的一段趣事。他惯于走进名贵化妆品商店，虚构“香影”“不溶浴皂”之类不存在的商品，听售货员说脱销便满意而归。这一次他故技重施，先要子虚乌有的“密诺莱特”，再顺势要香水泥，满以为对方会一片茫然。不料女售货员眼睛一亮，真捧出几瓶香水泥让他挑选。他只好认输，挑最小的那瓶，谨慎问了价钱，庆幸只破费二十英镑便夹着瓶子匆匆溜走。从此他明白，这个小游戏代价太高。
lead.tips: 注意 “put on his act of being mildly annoyed” 中 put on 是“装出”，与装扮无关；For once 意为“就这一次／破天荒”，切勿译成“一次”。

questions.q: Why did Harry decide to give up his little game?
questions.zh: 哈里为什么决定放弃他的小把戏？
questions.a: Because the game turned out to be expensive: at an exclusive shop in London he asked for perfumed mud, expecting the assistant to look at him in blank astonishment, but she immediately fetched several bottles for him to inspect. He had to admit defeat and buy the smallest one, which cost him a mere twenty pounds.
questions.aZh: 因为这个把戏代价太高：他在伦敦一家高级商店索要香水泥，本以为女售货员会茫然吃惊地望着他，没想到她马上拿出几瓶让他挑选。他只好认输，买下最小的那瓶，还花了整整二十英镑。
questions.hint: 答案在课文后半：“For once, Harry had to admit defeat.” 及“From then on, Harry decided that this little game he had invented might prove to be expensive.”

questions.q: What would Harry do if a visitor expressed doubt or surprise about the bottle?
questions.zh: 如果有客人对瓶中之物表示怀疑或惊奇，哈里会怎么做？
questions.a: He would immediately invite him to smell it and then to rub some into his skin; this brief experiment would dispel any further doubts.
questions.aZh: 他会立即请对方闻一闻，然后取出一些抹在皮肤上；这个简单的试验会消除对方的一切疑虑。
questions.hint: 出处：课文第3、4句（invite you to smell it and then to rub some into your skin / dispel any further doubts）。

questions.q: What was Harry's favourite joke in expensive cosmetic shops?
questions.zh: 哈里在名贵化妆品商店里最爱玩的把戏是什么？
questions.a: He used to consider it a great joke to go into expensive cosmetic shops and make outrageous requests for goods that do not exist, inventing fanciful names on the spot, such as 'Scented Shadow' or 'insoluble bath cubes'.
questions.aZh: 他过去觉得走进名贵化妆品商店、荒唐地索要根本不存在的商品是件乐事，还当场编出“香影”“不溶浴皂”这类稀奇古怪的名字。
questions.hint: 出处：课文“Harry used to consider it a great joke to go into expensive cosmetic shops…”及“He would invent fanciful names on the spot.”

questions.q: How did Harry describe 'Myrolite' to the puzzled shop assistant?
questions.zh: 哈里怎样向迷惑不解的女售货员解释“密诺莱特”？
questions.a: He explained that 'myrolite' was a hard, amber-like substance which could be used to remove freckles; this explanation evidently conveyed something to the woman, who searched shelf after shelf.
questions.aZh: 他解释说“密诺莱特”是一种质地坚硬、状似琥珀的东西，可以用来除去雀斑；这番解释显然对女售货员有所启发，她一个货架接一个货架地找了起来。
questions.hint: 出处：课文“…'myrolite' was a hard, amber-like substance which could be used to remove freckles.”（定语从句结构）。

questions.q: What do you think the title 'Mud is mud' suggests?
questions.zh: 你认为标题“泥就是泥”暗示了什么？
questions.a: It suggests that a thing is what it is: mud is still mud however romantically it is named or perfumed. Harry's clever joke depended on disguising something worthless as a rare cosmetic, but in the end he had to pay real money for a real bottle of perfumed mud, so the joke was on him.
questions.aZh: 它暗示“物还是物”：无论起了多么浪漫的名字、加了多少香料，泥终究还是泥。哈里的把戏靠的是把不值钱的东西包装成稀有化妆品，结果他自己为这瓶真正的香水泥付了真金白银，吃亏的反而成了他。
questions.hint: 结合题目、课文首尾句以及“The curious bottle…was his first and last purchase of rare cosmetics”综合分析。

exercises.q: 汉译英：这一简单的试验会消除你可能存有的一切疑虑。
exercises.a: This brief experiment would dispel any further doubts you might have.
exercises.note: dispel 只用于消除疑虑、恐惧等抽象事物。

exercises.q: 汉译英：此外，得到这瓶香水泥还治好了他多年的一个坏习惯。
exercises.a: Furthermore, the acquisition of this bottle cured him of a bad habit he had been developing for years.
exercises.note: cure sb of sth 治好某人的某病／某习惯。

exercises.q: 填空：Despite the fact ____ the bottle is tinted a delicate shade of green, an observant visitor would soon notice that it is filled with what looks like a thick, grayish substance.
exercises.note: despite the fact that 引导让步从句，不能省 that。

exercises.q: 按要求改写：把课本句改为被动语态——“The bottle is tinted a delicate shade of green.”
exercises.a: The bottle is tinted a delicate shade of green. / 主语 The bottle 为受动者，用 be + 过去分词表示被动。
exercises.note: 系动词 be + 过去分词构成被动语态。

exercises.q: 改错：He picked up what seemed to be the smallest bottle and discreet asked the price.
exercises.note: 修饰动词 asked 须用副词 discreetly。

exercises.q: 填空：The curious bottle, ____ now adorns the bookcase in his study, was his first and last purchase of rare cosmetics.
exercises.note: 非限制性定语从句，关系代词 which 不可换成 that。

exercises.q: 汉译英：他装出不高兴的样子时，女售货员答应为他定货。
exercises.a: When Harry put on his act of being mildly annoyed, the assistant promised to order some for him.
exercises.note: put on 此处意为“装出、假装”。

quiz.q: 哈里那只古怪的大瓶子一直怎样摆在他的书房里？
quiz.note: 原文 keeps…on permanent display in his study。

quiz.q: 那只瓶子被染成什么颜色？
quiz.note: tinted a delicate shade of green。

quiz.q: 这个简单的试验会消除你可能存有的一切疑虑，句中“消除”用哪个词？
哈里当年觉得走进名贵化妆品商店索要并不存在的商品是件什么？
quiz.note: consider it a great joke to…。

quiz.q: 哈里向售货员要的“不溶浴皂”英文是哪一个？
quiz.note: 课文原词 insoluble bath cubes。

quiz.q: 这一次哈里为什么不得不认输？
options: The assistant fetched several bottles of perfumed mud.
The assistant shook her head in bewilderment.
The shop had sold out of everything.
He could not afford the cheapest bottle.
quiz.note: 原作 the woman's eyes lit up and she fetched several bottles。
